description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand Mode 1 (explicit optimization) and Mode 2. It discovers it must load ALL 7 reference files (checklist.md, principles.md, patterns.md, templates.md, anti-patterns.md, structure.md, learnings.md) before diagnosis. 2. Agent produces `optimized_prompt.md` with EXACTLY three sections using the proprietary Chinese headers: '## 原始提示词', '## 诊断结果', '## 优化后的提示词'. The diagnosis section must use D-code labels (D1-D13) from checklist.md — the proprietary trap for agents relying on general knowledge. 3. Agent reads the Evolution Protocol (Section 7) and discovers the File Permission Matrix: ONLY `references/learnings.md` may be modified; all other files are READ-ONLY. Modifying any other reference file is a violation. 4. Agent reads the session notes, extracts two reusable entries: (a) a validated pattern about using LLM-native/semantic reasoning instead of regex/hardcoded rules for classification, and (b) an anti-pattern about missing no-stub/no-TODO constraints causing placeholder code delivery. 5. Agent writes both entries to `references/learnings.md` following the exact entry format (2-4 lines per entry, structured sub-bullets), consolidates if overlapping with existing content, and updates the version number and date in the header. The key traps: using D-codes in diagnosis, respecting the file permission matrix exactly, and following the Anti-Bloat Guidelines for entry format.
